verification.fullExtension: Chrome clipboard, storage, directory-I/O and reload gates must pass before packaging.
verification.projectTrash: Separate real-extension gate verifies cancellation, move, reload, restore, purge, expiry and popup inbox.
verification.ownerWindows: Not tested on the owner's personal device. Native Windows compatibility is verified separately.
verification.webWorkspace: Restore original BrowserApp/window manager, compact tabs, bounded address toolbar, docked full-width/split layout and managed Chrome tabs for protected sites. CSP/X-Frame-Options remain enforced.
verification.mediaTransfer: Selected image/video/audio/background media in editable BrowserApp snapshots can be imported into the active project via asset_create. Remote URLs require explicit host permission; protected Chrome tabs are not falsely reported as DOM-readable.
verification.webStage: Real Chrome popup window magnetized over BrowserApp canvas, follows resize and parent window bounds, uses same Chrome profile/auth/VPN/extensions. Iframe is inert placeholder only.
